主要内容: Nordic American Tankers Limited completed the acquisition of Scandic American Shipping Ltd. on January 11, 2013, as announced on December 17, 2012. NAT acquired 100% of Scandic's shares from a company controlled by Herbjørn Hansson, NAT's Chairman and CEO, and his family. NAT issued 1,910,112 common shares to the seller, subject to a one-year lock-up agreement. Following the acquisition, Mr. Hansson and his family own approximately 5.6% or 3.1 million shares of NAT's outstanding shares. The acquisition aligns their interests more closely with NAT's operations. The text includes a cautionary statement regarding forward-looking statements, highlighting uncertainties and risks associated with future performance and outcomes. Key factors affecting the company include global economic conditions, market fluctuations, changes in demand, operating expenses, regulatory changes, and potential litigation.
